questions.question: Does `src/client/group/epoch-snapshot.ts` export `EpochSnapshot` with exactly the fields `groupId`, `epoch`, `state`, and optional `appliedCommit` (containing `eventId`, `createdAt`, `contentHash`), and does it also export `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend` with methods `get`, `set`, `prune`, and `clear`? Are both names re-exported from `src/client/group/index.ts`? Provide (a) the TypeScript interface/type source text, (b) the re-export line in `index.ts`, and (c) a compilation check confirming no TypeScript error.

Does `MarmotGroupOptions` in `src/client/group/marmot-group.ts` include an optional `snapshots?: EpochSnapshotStoreBackend | EpochSnapshotStoreFactory` field, and does `MarmotGroup` default to an in-memory snapshot store with `snapshotDepth = 2` when the field is omitted? Show (a) the updated `MarmotGroupOptions` type definition, (b) the constructor code that applies the default, and (c) a test asserting that constructing without `snapshots` results in `snapshotDepth === 2`.

Does `src/extra/in-memory-epoch-snapshot-store.ts` export a named class `InMemoryEpochSnapshotStore` that implements `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend`, and is it re-exported from `src/extra/index.ts` so it is accessible via the `@internet-privacy/marmot-ts/extra` subpath? Show (a) the class declaration line, (b) the `src/extra/index.ts` re-export line, and (c) the `package.json` `exports` entry for `./extra`.

In `ingest()` in `src/client/group/marmot-group.ts`, is `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend.set` called with the pre-apply `SerializedClientState` plus the commit event's `eventId`, `createdAt`, and SHA-256 `contentHash` before `processMessage()` is invoked? And does `ingest()` propagate (not swallow) any error thrown by the snapshot store? Provide (a) the relevant `ingest()` code block, (b) the test that triggers a store throw and asserts propagation.

In `selfUpdate()` and `commit()`, is `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend.set` called with the pre-advance snapshot before `this.state` is updated (after `hasAck`), and does the existing `hasAck`-before-advance invariant remain intact? Show (a) the updated `selfUpdate()` and `commit()` code sections, and (b) a test that records the snapshot store calls and verifies the snapshot precedes the state update.

When `selfUpdate()` or `commit()` receives no relay ack (`!hasAck(response)`), does the implementation leave `this.state` unchanged, skip `save()`, and ensure that `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend.get` for the would-be new epoch returns `null`? Show (a) the publish-failure branch code, (b) a unit test that simulates `!hasAck` and then calls `get` on the snapshot store to confirm `null`.

After each commit advance, is `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend.prune` called with `keepAboveEpoch = currentEpoch - snapshotDepth`? Does a test using `InMemoryEpochSnapshotStore` with `snapshotDepth = 2`, after advancing from epoch 0 through epoch 5, confirm that snapshots for epochs 0, 1, and 2 are absent and at most snapshots for epochs 3 and 4 remain? Show (a) the prune call site, (b) the test assertions on epoch presence/absence.

When `MarmotGroup` is constructed without a `snapshots` option, does `snapshotDepth` default to 2, and after three consecutive commit advances does the snapshot store hold at most 2 entries (the two most recent pre-commit states)? Show the test that constructs without `snapshots` and verifies the retention count after three advances.

Does `src/client/group/epoch-snapshot.ts` contain no stub markers (`TODO`, `FIXME`, `XXX`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`), no dead code paths, and no unused local variables or parameters (the TypeScript build is strict on `noUnusedLocals` / `noUnusedParameters`)? Run `pnpm build` and confirm zero errors.

Does `src/client/group/epoch-snapshot.ts` import only from `src/core/` (for `SerializedClientState` and related types) and from no other `src/client/` module — specifically never from `marmot-group.ts`? Does `src/extra/in-memory-epoch-snapshot-store.ts` import only from `src/client/group/epoch-snapshot.ts` and no other `src/client/` module? Verify by checking the import lines in both files.

Could `epoch-snapshot.ts` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list (`src/core/` type imports only)? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist beyond what architecture.md permits, and do they flow through declared seam contracts? List every import in `epoch-snapshot.ts` and confirm each is within the allowed boundary.

Are the `EpochSnapshotStoreBackend` contract invariants (get-returns-null-before-set, set-then-get round-trip, prune removes entries at-or-below epoch, clear removes all entries for a group) each covered by at least one test in `InMemoryEpochSnapshotStore`'s test suite, and do those tests assert on observable state rather than internal spy calls?

Does `pnpm vitest run` pass for all files touched by S1 (`epoch-snapshot.ts`, `in-memory-epoch-snapshot-store.ts`, and the `marmot-group.ts` snapshot-wiring tests) with zero test failures and zero TypeScript compile errors?

Does the SHA-256 content hash stored in `appliedCommit.contentHash` use a stable, deterministic input (the raw commit event `content` field as a UTF-8 byte sequence), and is the same hashing utility reused consistently with the rest of the codebase (e.g. `@noble/hashes/sha256`)? Confirm there is no ad-hoc re-implementation of SHA-256 and no conditional content transformation before hashing.
